name: io.github.duongnq2798/vestiarion
title: Vestiarion
description: An AI treasury agent paying in USDC on Arc: read its decisions, ledger and books; add invoices.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: A Vestiarion workspace API key, sent as a bearer token. Use a read-only key unless the agent must add records: the write tools need a read-and-write key. No tool can approve or pay.

api_key.description: A workspace API key, created by an owner or an admin under Settings, API keys. Leave Can also add records clear for a read-only key.
